rationale: All three lenses ran and every spec requirement and acceptance criterion passes against the diff. No blocking findings; 3 pre-existing or adjacent items deferred (concurrent same-name create race returning an unmapped DB error; case-sensitive duplicate-path check; create_skill steps after the companion block, such as a None return from SkillRepository.update, are not rolled back) and about 14 dismissed as by-design per spec (non-atomic create-then-delete, blobs left in place, no BaseException handling, double decode on the create path, update_skill unchanged) or below the emission floor.

business_review.item: Req 1: invalid companion files return the same 400 and create no skill record
business_review.notes: create_skill calls _validate_companion_payloads before SkillRepository.create; tests assert create not called and no blob written.

business_review.item: Req 2: on failure after create, delete the new record, re-raise original, log cleanup failure without masking
business_review.notes: try/except Exception around upload+update calls _rollback_created_skill (own try/except with logger.error) then bare raise; upload, update and cleanup-failure tests.

business_review.item: Req 3: no blob cleanup on failure
Req 4: success and 409 paths unchanged; metric only on success
business_review.notes: 409 check precedes validation; metric call remains after the try block; failure tests assert no metric.

business_review.item: Req 5: error codes and messages for invalid paths identical
business_review.notes: Validation body moved verbatim into the helper; tests assert the three messages.

business_review.item: Design: static _validate_companion_payloads used by _upload_companion_files and create_skill
business_review.notes: Helper returns (path, bytes) pairs; update_skill goes through _upload_companion_files unchanged.

business_review.item: Non-goals respected (no seed-policy, blob GC or frontend changes)
business_review.notes: Diff touches only skill_service.py and test_skill_service.py.

business_review.item: 944-char companion path returns 400 and SkillRepository.create is not called
business_review.notes: Parametrized path-too-long case plus 943/944 boundary tests.

business_review.item: Duplicate or reserved SKILL.md path returns 400 with no record
business_review.notes: Reserved and duplicate cases assert 400 and create not called.

business_review.item: Non-validation error after create calls SkillRepository.delete with the new id and propagates the original
Valid create with companion files still passes existing two-phase tests unchanged
business_review.notes: No existing tests modified; they pass.

standards_review.notes: make ruff (format, check --fix, check) passed; code-quality guide lists no blocking rule violated.
No secrets, auth or injection surface touched; error messages unchanged from before.
